AI & Cybersecurity Insights

Your weekly briefing on the cutting edge of technology

This week's edition tracks AI as it slips between roles — weapon, target, and subject of regulation, sometimes all at once. Researchers are now using AI models to hack other AI companies, browser agents are being hijacked wholesale, and lawmakers on both coasts are scrambling to write rules for a technology that keeps outrunning them. Meanwhile, a quieter debate rages over whether the real danger is a dramatic AI takeover or a slow, boring surrender of human agency. Six stories, three lenses, one unmistakable throughline: the ground is shifting faster than our frameworks for understanding it.
